description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of Licence-Cancellation of the Licence issued to Asian Finance Limited
reasoning: This gazette content announces the cancellation of a finance business licence under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011. It constitutes a regulatory action by the Central Bank's Monetary Board, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning financial institution regulations and compliance requirements, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
